fix: Multi-server isolation (Block 17): two instances can no longer point their B3 at the same MySQL database (refused on save and on B3 start, B3_DATABASE_TARGET_SHARED). A master token or RCON password that another instance also holds is reported as a warning with the instance IDs only, never a value, and never blocks. A hand-edited server.cfg can no longer point g_log outside the instance's own directory, and logfile must be 0 to 2. Several instances with stored credentials can now be launched in parallel: the vault hand-over takes turns instead of failing the second launch with VAULT_OPERATION_BUSY.
notes: 4.18.22 source preflight with the multi-server gate (scripts/verify-4.18.22-multi-server-gate.mjs, fake core, three instances launched in parallel). The native check (scripts/verify-4.18.22-multi-server-native.mjs) with three real CoD4x cores has not been run yet. Development source, not a release.
architecture: Shared Runtime with Windows and Linux adapters; schema-based Config Engine; per-instance RCON, master status, master list verification, plugin manager and B3 runtime; per-instance network exposure; eBc-B3 dependency layer
